tool.name: GSASII Refinement: Interactive executor
tool.description: Tool for GSASII Rietveld refinement called from an interactive refinement tool
tool.command: conda init bash && source ../home/.bashrc && conda activate GSASII && mkdir app && cd app/ && touch $output && mkdir portal && ln -s $project gsas_project.gpx && ln -s $delta delta1 && python $__tool_directory__/gsas2_gpx_refinement.py --project-filename gsas_project.gpx --delta-filename delta1 --output-directory /portal --output-gpx $output_gpx --output-lst $output_lst --output-parameters $output_parameters > >(tee -a $output) 2> >(tee -a $output >&2)
tool.help: A tool to run a GSAS2 Rietveld refinement on a GSASII project file. This tool is intended to be called from the GSASII interactive refinement tool.
